headline: Türkiye Secures $26 Billion in Green Energy Deals During COP31 Summit
summary: Host nation Türkiye agreed to investment deals and development plans worth more than $26 billion during the COP31 climate conference. The commitments focus heavily on green energy infrastructure and clean power transitions.
why: Large international clean-energy investments directly boost foreign direct capital flows and power grid modernizations in emerging economies.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: The host nation locked in over $26 billion in clean energy and transition investments.
